# Motion Woods Private Limited

> Motion Woods Private Limited is a Pune-based manufacturing group for doors, kitchens, furniture, glass & windows, steel fabrication and finishes, plus full-home interiors. It is built on founder Diwakar R. Vishwakarma's 35+ years of woodworking (through his proprietorship firm Diwakar Furniture) — including 7,650+ doors delivered across just two townships and 20+ key builder clients in Pune. Products are manufactured in the company's own 12,000 sq ft factory at Nere, near Punawale, and installed by its own crew.

## Company Facts
- Legal name: Motion Woods Private Limited (also written Motion.Woods)
- Structure: parent company with dedicated brands per trade (see Brands)
- Registered office: Hadapsar, Pune – 411028, Maharashtra, India
- Factory: own 12,000 sq ft manufacturing unit at Nere, near Punawale, Pune, Maharashtra
- Phone: +91 98607 85024 / +91 94235 81923
- Email: admin@motionwoods.com
- Website: https://www.motionwoods.com
- Areas served: Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad and wider Maharashtra
- Leadership: Diwakar R. Vishwakarma (Director & Founder), Pramodkumar R. Gupta (Director), Anshu Diwakar Vishwakarma (CEO)
- Heritage: Founder brings 35+ years of woodworking; his firm Diwakar Furniture's team, machinery and processes now power Motion Woods. Experience belongs to the founder and legacy firm; the private limited company is newly structured.
- Model: factory manufacturing with quality control, plus installation by the company's own site crew.

## Brands (The Motion Woods Group)
- Motion Woods Doors — residential, commercial and institutional doors (teak, veneer, laminate, flush, WPC, fire-rated): https://www.motionwoods.com/wooden-door-manufacturer-pune
- Motion Woods Kitchens — modular and semi-modular kitchens: https://www.motionwoods.com/motionwoods-kitchens
- Motion Woods Furniture — beds, wardrobes, workstations, storage (residential, office, institutional): https://www.motionwoods.com/furniture-manufacturer-pune
- Motion Woods Glass & Windows — uPVC and aluminium windows, toughened glass, partitions, glazing: https://www.motionwoods.com/glass-windows-pune
- Motion Woods Steel Fabrication — railings, gates, grilles and structural steel (enquiry-based)
- Motion Woods Paints & Polish — PU, Duco, Melamine, emulsion; zero-drip, dust-controlled finishing: https://www.motionwoods.com/wood-polishing-finishing-pune

## Factory & Machinery
Own 12,000 sq ft factory at Nere, near Punawale, Pune, running: beam saw, hot press, cold press, post forming, edge banding (PUR) and CNC boring machines for panel sizing, lamination, edge finishing and precise hardware boring at scale.

## Track Record (delivered under the Diwakar Furniture legacy)
- Roshan Milestone, Tathawade (Roshan Realty): 3150+ doors, 1800+ frames, 661 apartments, 8 towers, 1.5 years
- Yashada Splendid Park I & II, Moshi-Alandi (Yashada Realty): 4500+ doors, 2650+ frames, 950 apartments, 9 towers, 2 years
- Park Street township, Wakad (Pride Purple Group): 65%+ of all door shutter & frame work
- ₹2 Cr luxury bungalow interior, Undri: 8 bedrooms, 6 months
- Clients include: Pride Purple Group, Yashada Realty, Roshan Realty, VTP Realty, Gera Developments, Bhate & Raje Construction, Kritija Construction, Kalpataru, Goel Ganga, Solitaire Group, Mantra Majestique
